description: UI/UX Enhancements: add persuasion triggers to the landing page, strengthen glassmorphism on dashboard cards, apply Neumorphism styling to calculator inputs, and add systematic tooltip + contextual help popovers across all CRUD forms.
steps: LANDING PAGE — PERSUASION TRIGGERS in resources/views/landing/home.blade.php. Add the following sections/elements, keeping existing HTML intact and inserting new blocks at appropriate positions: (a) AUTHORITY SEALS: insert a strip of trust badges (cadeado HTTPS, LGPD, '1.000+ usuários', 'Sem cartão de crédito') immediately below the hero CTA buttons. Use inline SVG lock icon and Font Awesome shields. (b) SCARCITY COUNTER: inside the pricing/plans section (search for the '#planos' anchor), add a small inline counter that reads 'Apenas [N] vagas restantes neste plano de lançamento' using an Alpine.js component x-data='{slots: 7}' so the number is easy to update. Styled as amber badge with fa-fire-flame-curved icon. (c) URGENCY TIMER: add a countdown banner above the CTA buttons that shows 'Oferta de lançamento termina em HH:MM:SS' driven by Alpine.js x-data with a setInterval countdown to a fixed UTC date 7 days from a hardcoded anchor (use a PHP now()->addDays(7)->toIso8601String() printed at render time so it restarts each deploy — that is acceptable for a launch counter). Hide with x-show when time hits zero. (d) BEFORE/AFTER TRANSFORMATION: insert a two-column side-by-side section between #servicos and #ferramentas anchors titled 'Antes e Depois' showing a stylized card: left side = 'Antes: planilhas dispersas, falta de controle, dívidas surpresa' (red icons), right side = 'Depois: painel unificado, metas alcançadas, sobra no fim do mês' (green icons). (e) 'NOVO' BADGES: on the AI Insights feature card and the Shared Wallets feature card inside the #features grid, add a 'Novo' pill badge (bg-accent-400 text-surface-950 text-xs font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full) in the card top-right corner. (f) 'EM BREVE' SECTION: insert an 'Em Breve' preview section before #faq containing 2–3 feature teasers (e.g., 'Integração bancária automática', 'App móvel nativo', 'Assistente IA por voz') as greyed-out cards with a 'Em breve' badge and an 'Receber aviso' WhatsApp CTA. (g) RECIPROCITY HIGHLIGHT: strengthen the existing free-plan callout. Add a visually distinct 'Comece grátis agora' floating card at the bottom of the hero that lists the 5 free plan benefits with checkmarks and links to register.

DASHBOARD GLASSMORPHISM in resources/views/dashboard/index.blade.php. The hero balance section (.relative.overflow-hidden.rounded-3xl) already uses bg-gradient-to-br. Enhance it: (a) Change the background to use bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-2xl on a dark surface layer instead of the opaque gradient — use 'bg-gradient-to-br from-primary-900/80 via-primary-800/80 to-primary-950/80 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/10'. (b) The three stat cards (income/expenses/projected) below the hero: add 'backdrop-blur-sm bg-white/80 dark:bg-surface-900/60 border border-white/20 dark:border-surface-700/40' classes, replacing the current 'bg-white dark:bg-surface-900'. This gives a glass card appearance without breaking structure.

NEUMORPHISM for calculator inputs in all resources/views/calculators/*.blade.php files (investment, interest, retirement, thirteenth-salary, vacation, financing, currency) and resources/views/simulators/*.blade.php files. Add a .nm-input CSS class definition to resources/css/app.css under the @layer components block: '.nm-input { @apply rounded-xl border-0 bg-surface-100 dark:bg-surface-800 shadow-[inset_2px_2px_5px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08),inset_-2px_-2px_5px_rgba(255,255,255,0.7)] dark:shadow-[inset_2px_2px_5px_rgba(0,0,0,0.3),inset_-2px_-2px_5px_rgba(255,255,255,0.05)] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary-500/30 transition-all; }'. Then replace the ad-hoc input class strings in calculator views with 'nm-input w-full px-4 py-2 text-surface-900 dark:text-white placeholder-surface-400 focus:outline-none'. Also add a '.nm-card { @apply rounded-2xl bg-surface-50 dark:bg-surface-800 shadow-[6px_6px_12px_rgba(0,0,0,0.07),-6px_-6px_12px_rgba(255,255,255,0.8)] dark:shadow-[6px_6px_12px_rgba(0,0,0,0.3),-6px_-6px_12px_rgba(255,255,255,0.03)]; }' class and apply it to the calculator widget wrapper divs.

TOOLTIP COMPONENT: add a reusable tooltip pattern to resources/views/components/ui/tooltip.blade.php as an anonymous Blade component. The component accepts: $text (tooltip content), $position ('top'|'right', default 'top'). Implementation: a wrapping <div class='relative inline-block group'>, a slot for the trigger element, and a hidden <div> that shows with group-hover: visibility using Tailwind classes 'absolute z-50 invisible group-hover:visible opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-150 bg-surface-900 dark:bg-surface-700 text-white text-xs rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 whitespace-nowrap shadow-lg' positioned based on $position prop. Use this component to wrap any <input>, <select>, or <button> that needs a tooltip hint. Update resources/views/wallets/create.blade.php and resources/views/wallets/edit.blade.php to wrap the 'Tipo', 'Saldo inicial', 'Dia de fechamento', and 'Dia de vencimento' inputs with <x-ui.tooltip text='...'> using descriptive pt-BR hints.

CONTEXTUAL HELP POPOVERS: add `x-data='{helpOpen: false}'` and a `?` button next to each form section header in: resources/views/wallets/create.blade.php, resources/views/transactions/create.blade.php, resources/views/goals/create.blade.php. The popover is an Alpine.js-driven `
`. Position the button inline with the form card's section header.

DESCRIPTIONS AND GUIDANCE TEXT: for all CRUD forms that currently lack hint text under fields, add `<x-ui.field ... hint='...' >` hint attributes (the existing x-ui.field component renders hints as .input-hint class). Add hints in pt-BR to: (a) resources/views/wallets/create.blade.php — name: 'Ex: Nubank, Itaú, Cartão Visa', type: 'Conta corrente, poupança, dinheiro em espécie ou cartão de crédito', balance: 'Saldo atual na data de hoje. Pode ser negativo para cartão de crédito.'. (b) resources/views/goals/create.blade.php (if it exists; create it following the pattern of wallets/create) — name: 'Ex: Viagem para Europa, Reserva de emergência', target_amount: 'Quanto você precisa economizar no total', deadline: 'Data limite para atingir a meta'. (c) resources/views/transactions/create.blade.php — description: 'Descreva a transação brevemente. Ex: Conta de luz, Salário, Uber', amount: 'Valor em reais. Use ponto ou vírgula como separador decimal', category: 'Escolha uma categoria para facilitar os relatórios'.
acceptance_criteria: resources/views/landing/home.blade.php contains all 7 persuasion elements: authority seals strip, scarcity counter with Alpine.js x-data, urgency countdown with setInterval, Before/After transformation section, 'Novo' badges on AI and wallet-sharing cards, 'Em breve' section with 3 teasers, reciprocity free-plan callout
resources/views/dashboard/index.blade.php hero balance card uses backdrop-blur-2xl and bg-white/5 glass layer
resources/css/app.css contains .nm-input and .nm-card utility classes under @layer components
All 7 calculator views use nm-input class on their numeric input fields
resources/views/components/ui/tooltip.blade.php exists and is used in wallets/create.blade.php on at least 4 fields
Help ? popover buttons exist in wallets/create, transactions/create, and goals/create forms
resources/views/wallets/create.blade.php fields have descriptive hint attributes
composer test passes (PagesSmokeTest, PublicPagesTest, all existing tests green)
verification: npm run build — exits 0 with no errors
composer test — all tests pass including PagesSmokeTest (covers dashboard, all calculator/simulator pages)
findings: 1) .nm-input and .nm-card added to @layer components in app.css — subsequent FEATs can use these classes freely. 2) Dashboard hero uses bg-gradient-to-br from-primary-900/80 via-primary-800/80 to-primary-950/80 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/10 (not the opaque from-primary-800 gradient anymore). 3) Stat cards use backdrop-blur-sm bg-white/80 dark:bg-surface-900/60 border border-white/20 dark:border-surface-700/40. 4) New component resources/views/components/ui/tooltip.blade.php — props: text (string), position (top|right). 5) WhatsApp links in public views MUST match https://wa.me/5541996924829?text=... — the CrawlerTest validates this pattern strictly. 6) The transaction form is in resources/views/transactions/partials/form.blade.php (shared by create and edit). 7) Calculator/simulator form card wrappers now use nm-card class; numeric inputs use nm-input class.
